caption: The drawing depicts a wooden cabinet with three main sections, rendered in shades of brown to represent wood grain, with added detailing in black, red, and a bit of gray. The upper section features three small panels, with the two outer panels showcasing geometric stars and the central panel displaying a cross-like design. These three panels are bordered by two short, thick, turned columns colored mainly in black. Beneath this section are two rectangular drawers, each with an elongated hexagonal motif and centered black knob handles. The main lower section consists of three doors: the central door has a symmetrical floral and geometric decorative motif, while each of the two side doors exhibits a vertical stylized plant or floral pattern. Flanking the central lower door, there are additional vertical decorations, one on each side, mirroring the black and wood-colored designs seen in the upper section. The legs are simple, squared, and match the cabinet’s primary wood tone. The entire cabinet stands out against a plain, unadorned off-white or light beige background.
title: Hartford Cupboard
